title.value: Learning GFlowNets From Partial Episodes For Improved Convergence And Stability
title.justification: This is the exact title of the paper, as indicated by the header and the central focus of the document.
title.quote: Learning GFlowNets From Partial Episodes For Improved Convergence And Stability

extractions.description: The paper explores Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) and introduces a new learning objective called subtrajectory balance (SubTB(𝜆)). SubTB aims to enhance the convergence and stability of GFlowNets by learning from partial action subsequences of varying lengths. The study suggests that SubTB(𝜆) can improve the training of GFlowNets in environments with sparse rewards or longer action sequences. It also compares SubTB's effectiveness against existing GFlowNet objectives and highlights its benefits in terms of reducing variance and improving credit assignment during training.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving algorithmic methods for training generative flow networks, with no explicit mention of climate, ecology, or sustainable development objectives.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Generative flow networks (GFlowNets) are a family of algorithms for training a sequential sampler of discrete objects under an unnormalized target density and have been successfully used for various probabilistic modeling tasks.
